## Skill Checklist (for new skills)

If adding a new skill, please ensure:

- [ ] File is in the correct `skills/` category folder
- [ ] File follows the [skill template structure](CONTRIBUTING.md#skill-template)
- [ ] File has at least 150 lines
- [ ] Contains all required sections:
  - [ ] When to Use
  - [ ] Design Philosophy
  - [ ] Decision Priority
  - [ ] Instructions for AI Assistant
  - [ ] Prompt Templates (at least 3 variations)
  - [ ] Style Reference (with color palettes / hex codes)
  - [ ] Common Patterns
  - [ ] Pitfalls to Avoid
- [ ] Descriptions in Chinese, prompts/technical terms in English
- [ ] File named with lowercase-hyphens convention
- [ ] README.md skills table updated
